title: Operators
description: The operators of OPE (ADR-031): the file named by OPE_ADMIN_OPERATORS_FILE (this object) or the JSON of OPE_ADMIN_OPERATORS (this object, or the bare array of operators). Without operators nobody administers. Tokens never appear: only their fingerprints (`node scripts/mint-admin-token.mjs` mints both). Shape only: the rules are the Operator's.

$schema.description: Path of this schema, for the editor.

operatorId.description: Identifier of the operator, as the administration log records it.

tokenFingerprints.description: SHA-256 fingerprints (hex) of the operator's bearer tokens (`Authorization: Bearer ope_at_…`). One or two: a rotation keeps both for a while.

scope.description: Which merchants the operator reaches: `"*"` for every merchant, or the list of merchant identifiers; a merchant out of scope answers 403 like a nonexistent one.
